incident-bot: INCIDENT: Rising funcall parser errors for customer FjordCorp (vpc-fjord-1). Error rate 18% over 5m, paging failures observed. Paging storm correlating with recent schema change. Paging threshold breached -> page queue growth.

alex.cheng: paging alerts just hit my phone. I'm looking at vpc-fjord-1 pool now. can someone grab the customer impact?

fjord-ops: seeing timeouts on our side for large list endpoints. Clients receive repeated 412/parse_error during pagination. High traffic from our billing microservice.

priya.rao: confirmed. funcall parser (lib/func_parser v2.3.1) started rejecting responses with optional "details": null fields after last deploy. Likely schema optional->nullable mismatch.

samir.khan: ok. quick triage — is this in the dedicated pool only or global?

alex.cheng: it's isolated to dedicated pool vpc-fjord-1 (dedicated-gpu-12). Other customers on the shared pool unaffected.

lina-g: I see repeated stacktraces in parser pods: `TypeError: expected object at $.payment.items[*].price, got null` — handler fails and we drop the page -> triggers retry -> duplicate pages -> queue growth.

priya.rao: root cause appears to be model output shape changed slightly for new model variant (llm-orange-1.2). JSONPaths that assumed non-null numbers now hitting null. Parser throws instead of soft-accepting.

samir.khan: P1 for customer impact. Paging fallout: requests hang in frontend for up to 30s before upstream retry, causing client timeouts. Suggest immediate mitigation: enable parser compatibility shim for FjordCorp and route them to llm-orange-1.1 fallback.

alex.cheng: I'm rolling compatibility config now. Command: ``redwoodctl routes update --tenant fjordcorp --compat-parser=on --model-fallback=llm-orange-1.1``

deploy-bot: deploy request received by deploy pipeline (rollout-id: dr-2165432100-compat). Canarying to 2/8 nodes in vpc-fjord-1.

priya.rao: while rollout goes, pushing a hotfix to parser: change strict parse to `allow_null_numbers=true` and fall back to 0.0 for missing numeric fields. PR linked: https://git.redwood/repo/func-parser/pull/471

lina-g: logs after enabling compat-shim: parser errors drop from 18% -> 2% in canary. Paging queue reduces.

fjord-ops: thanks, seeing improved behavior on our test traffic. Production is still noisy but recovering.

samir.khan: we should also add a guard to prevent infinite paging loops: add a max_retry_pages=3 and return partial results with warning. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

alex.cheng: agreed. I'm notifying support to tell FjordCorp SREs about mitigation and expected timeline for full rollback to stable model.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: deploy dr-2165432100-compat successful on 8/8 nodes at 2165432190. Error rate down to 1.8%.

priya.rao: post-mortem notes to capture: model-variant onboarding didn't run schema-contract tests for nullable numeric fields. We need an eval harness that injects nulls into common numeric paths.

lina-g: mitigation checklist completed: compat-shim enabled, fallback model pinned, parser hotfix deployed, paging throttles applied (max_retry_pages=3), support notified.

alex.cheng: handing off to next oncall for follow-up monitoring. @samir.khan you're up for the 4h watch. Please confirm and track any regressions.

samir.khan: taking it. I'll keep an eye for recurrence and coordinate with fw-team to add schema tests.

fjord-ops: appreciate the fast response. We'll revert any client-side retries once you confirm stability.

alex.cheng: post-incident ACTIONS: 1) Add nullable-field tests to model onboarding (owner: priya). 2) Add parser compat config to per-tenant runtime controls (owner: alex). 3) Billing microservice on FjordCorp to be advised to backoff on retries (owner: fjord-ops). 4) SRE to add paging queue alerts (owner: samir).

priya.rao: creating jira RED-8423 for onboarding tests.

samir.khan: creating RED-8424 for paging alerting and RED-8425 for max_retry_pages enforcement.

alex.cheng: marking incident as mitigated. will draft short blameless postmortem and share in #incidents. thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Condition cleared at 2165432315. Final error rate 0.9% on vpc-fjord-1.
